hadith.title: In Light of Hadith
hadith.subtitle: The sayings of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) about Qard al-Hasan

hadith1.text: Whoever takes people's wealth intending to repay it, Allah will repay it on his behalf. And whoever takes it intending to waste it, Allah will destroy him.

hadith2.text: Whoever takes a loan and does not intend to repay it, will meet Allah as a thief.

hadith3.text: All the sins of a martyr are forgiven except debt.

quran.title: In Light of Quran
quran.subtitle: Allah's words about interest and lending

ayah1.text: Who is it that would loan Allah a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward.

ayah2.text: O you who have believed, fear Allah and give up what remains of interest, if you should be believers.

ayah3.text: Those who consume interest cannot stand on the Day of Resurrection except as one stands who is being beaten by Satan into insanity. That is because they say, 'Trade is just like interest.' But Allah has permitted trade and has forbidden interest.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes what Hasnahena Foundation records about you, who else holds it, and how long it is kept. It describes what the system actually does — where a right has a limit, the limit is stated here rather than left out.

collect.title: What we collect
collect.content: To become a member you give us your name, date of birth, your parents’ names, your present and permanent address, your mobile number, an email address, your national ID number, a photograph of that ID document and a photograph of yourself, and the name and details of your nominee. Once you are a member we also hold the record of everything that happens to your money: every deposit, withdrawal, loan, instalment and donation, and who processed it.

why.title: Why we collect it
why.content: Identity details establish that you are eligible for membership and that the person at the counter is the person who owns the account. Nominee details decide who receives your savings if you die. The financial record is the account itself — it is what your balance is calculated from, and it is checked against the sum of every posting every hour.

processors.title: Who else holds it
processors.content: We do not sell your information and we do not share it for marketing. Three services hold parts of it on our behalf: Cloudinary stores the photographs, including the image of your national ID; Brevo delivers the emails we send you; and Neon hosts the database. Staff of the foundation see what their role requires — a field worker sees the members they serve, an administrator sees the whole membership — and every change to money is recorded against the person who made it. We disclose information beyond this only when the law requires it.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.content: The financial record is permanent. It has to be: a posting whose owner has vanished does not make the accounts smaller, it makes them permanently wrong. Identity details are not permanent. If your application is refused, the photograph of your national ID and the photograph of you are deleted straight away, when the decision is made; the decision and its reason are kept, and your national ID number, your parents’ names, your date of birth and your addresses are erased {rejectedDays} days after the refusal. If you leave and your account was never used, your record is deleted outright. If you leave and money has moved through your account, your record is anonymised instead — your name, contact details, ID number and photographs are removed and the postings remain, attached to an account number that no longer identifies anybody. The record of who did what is kept to match: anything about money or about a decision made concerning you is kept permanently, our record of password changes and failed sign-in attempts for {securityDays} days, and routine entries such as an ordinary sign-in for {routineDays} days.

rights.title: Your rights, and where they stop
rights.content: You may ask to see what we hold about you, to correct anything that is wrong, and to have your identity details erased. Ask at the office and we will act on it. The one thing we cannot do is delete the financial record of an account that has been used, for the reason above; erasure of such an account means anonymisation, and we will tell you which of the two applies to you before we do it. Corrections to money are never made by overwriting: a mistaken posting is corrected by adding a further posting, so the history stays readable.

security.title: How it is protected
security.content: Passwords are stored only as a one-way hash, so nobody at the foundation can read yours. Sessions expire, and changing your password ends every other session immediately. Access needs a signed-in account with a role that permits it. Every change to a balance is written to an audit log that cannot be edited, only added to — the database itself refuses an attempt to alter one — and those entries are never deleted.

contact.title: Asking us about this
contact.content: For anything in this policy — a request to see your record, a correction, an erasure, or a question about it — contact the office. The address, phone number and email are at the bottom of every page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your membership of Hasnahena Foundation and your use of this platform.

acceptance.title: Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing and using the Hasnahena Foundation services, you accept and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

service.title: Service Description
service.content: Hasnahena Foundation provides interest-free cooperative finance to its members — savings accounts, Qard al-Hasan loans, and the tools to manage them. Our services operate under Islamic finance principles.

registration.title: Account Registration
registration.content: To use our services you must register for an account and provide accurate, complete information. Membership is granted by decision of the foundation and may be refused. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for everything done under your account.

responsibilities.title: Member Responsibilities
responsibilities.content: Members agree to use our services only for lawful purposes, provide truthful information, make timely repayments on any loans, and comply with all applicable laws and regulations.

loans.title: Loan Terms
loans.content: Loans provided by Hasnahena Foundation are interest-free. There is no profit rate, no markup, no service charge and no administrative or processing fee — you repay exactly the amount you borrowed and not one taka more. A late or missed instalment carries no penalty and no additional charge of any kind. Specific repayment schedules and conditions are set out in your individual loan agreement.

records.title: Official Records
records.content: The Foundation's official physical books, registers and signed documents are the authoritative record of every membership, deposit, withdrawal and loan. This website is provided for convenience and may contain errors, omissions or delays. Where anything shown on this website conflicts with the Foundation's physical records, the physical records prevail.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.content: Your use of our services is also governed by our Privacy Policy, which sets out what we record, who else holds it and how long it is kept. Please read it.

termination.title: Termination
termination.content: We may terminate or suspend your account for violation of these terms. You may close your account at any time by contacting us; how your record is treated afterwards is described in the Privacy Policy.

changes.title: Changes to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time. We will notify members of significant changes. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the new terms.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: For questions about these Terms of Service, contact the office. The address, phone number and email are at the bottom of every page.
